aarti.tek: Śrī Govardhana Mahārāja, O Mahārāja, a crown shines on your head.
aarti.pad1: Betel leaves are offered to you, flowers are offered to you, and a stream of milk is poured over you. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Your parikramā is seven kos long; Cakaleśvara is its resting place. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: A necklace adorns your neck; on your chin are a diamond and a ruby. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Earrings gleam in your ears; the adorned sight of you is grand. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Lord, holder of Girirāja, I am in your refuge: carry the devotee's boat across. ॥5॥
